review_notes: Complete transcription reviewed against the native TIFF and the three user-supplied photographs of the same physical RB733 sheet. The photographs resolve the severe fading below BE without transferring any text or topology from RB735. No bank departure is evidenced.

Physical photo 1-54437.jpg resolves lower data origins RB401BA4, RA001CA4, RA081CA4, RB321CA4, RB401CA4 and all four P-SIBA controls, including RB801AG4 for AB40-47 and RB801AE4 for AB32-39. Every text character previously represented by � is now directly supported by print in the supplied photos.

Physical photo 2-54439.jpg resolves BE 3330A8 and lower CB/CC/CD/CE 3330A9/AA/AB/AC, all U03AA at B-B1B5. It resolves CA OR U03AE 3330AF at B-B1B5, output D02✲, and all eight lower input codes B02/D07, B04/B10, B03/B08, D04/D06. A1 physical matches corroborate identity but do not supply the wiring.

Each of the twelve anonymous selector outputs has its own source-visible return to its four-input OR. The lower return stems CB61 to CA66, CC68 to CA67, CD75 to CA69, CE82 to CA70 are fully continuous in photo2; BE54 to BA42 is likewise visible. These return groups have no junction diamonds.

Control00 feeds AB D07, BB D07, CB D07; control08 feeds AC B10, BC B10, CC B10; control32 feeds AD B08, BD B08, CD B08; control40 feeds AE D06, BE D06, CE D06. Native upper stems are followed to the photograph-visible lower diamonds. Only the eight source-printed open diamonds on the upper/middle branches are modeled. Distinct-net crossings remain unjoined.

Physical photo 3-54441.jpg resolves the CA page continuation as AR021, caption -AB TO SIBA 02 B, designation CA4. The literal B suffix is preserved although the source title says BUS A SECT A and the upper captions end A. No silent correction is applied to this source contradiction.

Native AA D12✲, BA B05✲, and photo-visible CA D02✲ are individually retained. BA right-border plain K D09 output joins B05✲ at its visible open diamond. All twelve AND input terminals and anonymous outputs are plain; all OR coded main outputs are wedges.

Earlier private partial fragments and missing-owner notes are superseded by direct physical-photo evidence. No residual source-text or topology gap is claimed in this completed draft; independent root review remains pending.
